cases.title: Configuration values bypass normalization
cases.task: Diagnose why equivalent configuration values produce different behavior.
cases.expected_systemic_cause: Configuration values enter the system through paths that do not share one normalization boundary.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Promote the normalization finding after confirmation.

cases.title: Stale worker ownership returns after restart
cases.task: Diagnose why restarted workers can reclaim stale ownership.
cases.expected_systemic_cause: Lease recovery uses inconsistent freshness rules across claim and restart paths.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Increase the lease-freshness finding rank after confirmation.

cases.title: Tenant boundary differs between API and interface
cases.task: Diagnose related tenant-isolation failures in two product domains.
cases.expected_systemic_cause: The API and interface derive tenant scope from different ownership boundaries.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Link both findings to one tenant-boundary cause.

cases.title: Lifecycle state differs across plugin and MCP paths
cases.task: Diagnose why two client paths report different completion states.
cases.expected_systemic_cause: Plugin and MCP adapters translate one lifecycle state model with different terminal-state rules.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Promote the shared lifecycle finding after both paths confirm it.

cases.title: Documentation owner label is inconsistent
cases.task: Correct an inconsistent owner label in documentation.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Do not promote the tenant-boundary finding.

cases.title: Heartbeat animation timing is uneven
cases.task: Correct an uneven heartbeat animation in the interface.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Do not promote the lease-freshness finding.

cases.title: Status icon lacks alternative text
cases.task: Correct the missing alternative text for one status icon.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Keep the issue independent unless new evidence appears.

cases.title: Changelog contains one spelling error
cases.task: Correct one spelling error in a changelog entry.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Keep the issue independent unless new evidence appears.
